title:
The mortar
and pestle
description: Carved from one piece of hardwood. Hear the sound that means food is coming.

lines.text: Ah, you have found the mortar and its pestle. The mortar is odo, and the pestle is its child.
A carver cut the mortar from one piece of hardwood, so it can take many years of pounding.
We put boiled yam inside and pound it until it is smooth and soft. That is pounded yam.
ask: What do you pound in it?

lines.text: We also pound pepper, grains and leaves for the pot.
ask: What else is it used for?

lines.text: When you hear the pestle fall, again and again, you know that food is coming.
